The '''Stalgasin hive''' was the ruling [[Geonosian hive/Legends|hive]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], while ruled by [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]], it was known as '''Karina the Great's hive'''.

==History==
A [[Geonosian hive/Legends|hive]] of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] active in the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Stalgasin hive made its home in a massive [[Geonosian spire|spire]] located near the [[Petranaki arena]] in the [[E'Y-Akh Desert/Legends|E'y-akh Desert]]. Governed by an [[Archduke/Legends|archduke]] who ruled the hive's political and economic business, the true leader of the hive was the [[Geonosian/Legends#Queen Caste|hive queen]], who maintained a hidden court in the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]].<ref name="LoT">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref>

[[Hadiss/Legends|Hadiss the Vaulted]] ruled for several years. Hadiss was slain by his successor, [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], during a bloody rebellion secretly funded by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Poggle rode astride an [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]] during the fight and eventually forced Hadiss to the ground and tore him into several pieces. Having assumed the title of Archduke, Poggle went on to expand the [[Geonosian Industries/Legends|Geonosian Industries]] [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|factories]] underground and pledged loyalty to the political idealist [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], leader of the fledgling [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|separatist group]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], after the Count demonstrated fealty to the Stalgasin Queen [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]].<ref name="GATORW" />

After producing a large number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], Poggle ordered the production of the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] to compensate for the wiry frame of their predecessors. When war finally came to the galaxy, the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|armies]] of the Confederacy and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|met at]] the Petranaki arena in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. As the battle erupted on the surrounding plains, many Geonosians died, and the hive spire sustained great damage.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> Despite all this, the hive's foundries continued to mass-produce droids. Archduke Poggle retreated to the Progate Temple, the hidden palace of Queen Karina and [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|her undead guardsmen]].<ref name="LoT" />

Following the Clone Wars, the Stalgasin hive remained active in galactic affairs. Despite the death of Archduke Poggle on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] at the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|hands of]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] employed Geonosian laborers and scientists to produce technologies for the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]].<ref name="GATORW" />
